prompt: How many years after the founding of the 50th most populous US city, based on 2023 estimate population data, did Frank Fox receive UK Patent (1344259)?
answer:
The 50th most populous U.S. city in 2023 was **Aurora, Colorado**, with an estimated population of about **395,052**. Aurora was founded in **1880**.

Frank Fox received UK Patent **1,344,259** on **January 16, 1974**.

**1974 − 1880 = 94 years**

So, he received the patent **94 years after Aurora was founded**.
